newsitem.title: USA: Kiwi Int'l Air flight attendants approve contract.
newsitem.headline: Kiwi Int'l Air flight attendants approve contract.

text.p: Flight attendants at Kiwi International Air Lines ratified an 18-month contract by more than a two-to-one margin, the privately-held airline said.
Details of the contract were not disclosed.
"We were pleased with the speed of negotiations and the outcome of the contract," said Jerry Murphy, Kiwi's president and chief executive.
The flight attendants are the only union-organized employee group at the low-cost carrier. The flight attendants are represented by the Transport Worker's Union of America.
Kiwi returned to scheduled service in January after suspending flights in October as part of its Chapter 11 bankruptcy reorganization.
